style_en: Japanese TV anime style, crisp clean line art, cel-shaded coloring, calm muted colors, bright even lighting. The same art style in every episode. The background is always pure white.
avoid_en: any text, letters, logos, modern buildings or clothes, horned helmets, comic-book superhero armor or capes, Japanese or Chinese clothing, nudity, blood

thor.desc_en: Thor, the Norse god of thunder, a burly broad-chested man about 35 with a thick red beard and long red hair partly braided, fierce bright blue eyes, Viking Age clothing: a knee-length dark red wool tunic with woven trim, a thick leather belt with an iron buckle, gray wool trousers wrapped with leg bindings, leather shoes, iron gauntlets, and a heavy iron hammer with a short handle

tyr.desc_en: Tyr, a Norse god, a lean stern man about 40 with short dark-blond hair and a trimmed beard, a calm grave face, Viking Age clothing: a dark blue wool tunic, a brown wool cloak pinned with a round bronze brooch, wool trousers with leg bindings, his right hand missing at the wrist and the stump wrapped in pale cloth, a plain sword at his left hip

odin.desc_en: Odin, the chief of the Norse gods, a tall old man with a long gray beard, only one eye (his left eye closed with an old scar), a wide-brimmed gray hat, a long dark blue hooded wool cloak, Viking Age clothing, holding a long spear, a black raven on his shoulder
